verdict.rationale: Trilegal's Knowledge Repository publishes Updates, Analysis pieces and videos searchable by practice area, including an ESOP-buyback tax analysis, so there is some Indian startup-instrument content. Its footprint is India-only, so for founders in other markets it would not cover instruments like EMI, VSOP or BSPCE. Missing for 10: evidence of dedicated publications on Indian FDI rules for startups, broader ESOP/startup-instrument content beyond a single buyback-tax item, any coverage of non-Indian instruments, and independent corroboration.
